==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am excited about a game. The sky is incredibly blue. Pink flower petals are falling from above like snow.

Floating in the sky is a blue eyed person with a very thick mane of long blonde hair. They are wearing a tight white jacket with long oversized sleeves and black boots. Their name is Petal Stein, which seems to suggest they have some connection to the raining flower petals.

I feel as if Petal Stein is also connected to the game. I feel as if there is a countdown clock in my head for when the game will begin. Just as the game is supposed to start, my alarm goes off and I wake up.
